sentences.zh: 在那些更关心劳工问题、更关心环境问题的人身上更为强烈。

sentences.en: They were more likely to avoid, you know, avoid this information in order to kind of avoid this
sentences.zh: 他们更有可能回避，你知道的，回避这些信息，以此来

sentences.en: conflict.
sentences.zh: 避免这种冲突。

sentences.en: Think of the deep irony of what Neeru just said.
sentences.zh: 想想尼鲁刚刚说的话中深刻的讽刺意味。

sentences.en: The folks who care the most about ethics
sentences.zh: 那些最关心道德的人

sentences.en: might be most willing to turn a blind eye to unethical business practices because they know
sentences.zh: 可能最愿意对不道德的商业行为视而不见，因为他们知道

sentences.en: if they found out about those practices, they would feel obliged to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们发现了这些行为，就会觉得自己有义务采取行动。

sentences.en: We've talked about the many ways in which consumers and companies play games with one another,
sentences.zh: 我们已经讨论了消费者和公司互相博弈的种种方式，

sentences.en: using products to speak on their behalf or using products behind which they can hide.
sentences.zh: 他们用产品来代表自己发言，或者把产品当作藏身之所。

sentences.en: But there's one dimension of economic activity we haven't explored, and that's time.
sentences.zh: 但经济活动中还有一个我们尚未探讨的维度，那就是时间。

sentences.en: I asked Neeru how some of us use our calendars to broadcast our social status.
sentences.zh: 我问尼鲁，我们当中有些人是如何利用日程表来宣示社会地位的。

sentences.en: It used to be that
sentences.zh: 过去，

sentences.en: people once broadcast their social status by being idle.
sentences.zh: 人们曾经通过无所事事来宣示自己的社会地位。

sentences.en: But that idea has been turned on its head in
sentences.zh: 但在美国，

sentences.en: the United States.
sentences.zh: 这种观念已经被彻底颠覆了。

sentences.en: It turns out nowadays that people who are busier actually seem to have more
sentences.zh: 现在事实证明，那些更忙碌的人似乎反而拥有更高的

sentences.en: social status.
sentences.zh: 社会地位。

sentences.en: So rather than somebody who is very wealthy, who could waste their time, take fancy
sentences.zh: 所以，与那些非常有钱、可以浪费时间、进行豪华

sentences.en: vacations, you know, invest in learning these kind of archaic mannerisMs. It turns out the person who
sentences.zh: 度假、你知道的、投资学习这些陈旧礼仪的人不同，事实证明，那个

sentences.en: works really hard, who's really busy, who's very effortful, is the one who's seen to have more
sentences.zh: 工作极其努力、非常忙碌、付出很多努力的人，才是被认为拥有更高

sentences.en: social status.
sentences.zh: 社会地位的人。

sentences.en: And I think in part, that is because we live in a society that values social mobility.
sentences.zh: 我想部分原因在于，我们生活在一个崇尚社会流动性的社会里。

sentences.en: So we actually conducted the study in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上在美国进行了这项研究，

sentences.en: and we conducted the same study in Italy.
sentences.zh: 我们也在意大利进行了同样的调查。

sentences.en: And we found
sentences.zh: 我们发现，

sentences.en: that for Italian people, they thought the person who was living a life of leisure had more status.
sentences.zh: 对于意大利人来说，他们认为过着悠闲生活的人更有地位。

sentences.en: Of course, they have so much money, they can just relax all the time.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们有那么多钱，可以一直放松。

sentences.en: Whereas in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 而在美国，

sentences.en: they thought the person who was working all the time actually had more status.
sentences.zh: 他们认为整天都在工作的人其实更有地位。

sentences.en: And I think what was
sentences.zh: 我想其中

sentences.en: going on was that in the U.S., people sort of value this sense of earned status.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，在美国，人们某种程度上珍视这种“靠努力获得的地位”的概念。

sentences.en: So status can be earned
sentences.zh: 所以在美利坚，地位是可以靠努力挣来的，

sentences.en: in the U.S., where I think in Italy, it's more of a society where status is inherited.
sentences.zh: 而在我看来，在意大利，那更是一个地位靠继承的社会。

sentences.en: So for example,
sentences.zh: 所以举个例子，

sentences.en: my co-author is Italian, and she's always talking about how people come from good families or not.
sentences.zh: 我的合著者是个意大利人，她总是谈论人们是否出身名门。

sentences.en: And so there's very much this idea that your status isn't necessarily something that you earn,
sentences.zh: 因此，这里有这样一种强烈观念：你的地位不一定是你自己挣来的，

sentences.en: but you inherit.
sentences.zh: 而是你继承得来的。

sentences.en: And so in that sense, working hard really wouldn't get you anywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种意义上，努力工作其实并不能带你走向任何地方。

sentences.en: Whereas in
sentences.zh: 而在

sentences.en: America, you have the sense that you can actually climb the ladder.
sentences.zh: 美国，你会有一种感觉，觉得你确实可以往上爬。

sentences.en: And so celebrities, for example, might say, instead of saying, you know, I make one movie every year and
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，名人们可能会说，他们不会说“我每年拍一部电影，

sentences.en: I get to hang out on the beach for the other 10 months of the year, they actually are suggesting,
sentences.zh: 剩下的十个月我都在海滩上闲逛”，相反，他们实际上是在暗示自己

sentences.en: overworked.
sentences.zh: 工作过度。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we actually looked at tweets of celebrities who were tagged with this hashtag
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上查看了被贴上这个标签的名人推文：

sentences.en: humblebrag, this idea of bragging, but sort of disguising it as a complaint.
sentences.zh: 凡尔赛炫耀（humblebrag），这种炫耀的想法，但将其伪装成一种抱怨。

sentences.en: And a lot of the
sentences.zh: 我们发现的许多

sentences.en: ones, a lot of the tweets we found had to do with being busy.
sentences.zh: 推文、许多内容都与“很忙”有关。

sentences.en: So, you know, I have to be in the
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，“我今天早上必须去

sentences.en: recording studio this morning, and then I have a book meeting in the afternoon, and then I have to
sentences.zh: 录音室，下午要开图书会议，然后晚上我还得

sentences.en: travel to New York in the evening, and hashtag, I have no life.
sentences.zh: 赶往纽约”，话题标签：我没有生活。

sentences.en: You know, these kinds of tweets,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这类推文，

sentences.en: you're trying to say something about yourself.
sentences.zh: 你其实是在借此表达关于你自己的某种看法。

sentences.en: You're busy, you're really important.
sentences.zh: 你很忙，你真的很重要。

sentences.en: You don't
sentences.zh: 你没有

sentences.en: have time to do other things.
sentences.zh: 时间去做别的事情。

sentences.en: And so you see that on social media, that's kind of an acceptable
sentences.zh: 所以你在社交媒体上会看到，这是一种相当被接受

sentences.en: and effective way to show your status by telling people how busy you are.
sentences.zh: 且有效的方式，通过告诉别人你有多忙来展现你的地位。

sentences.en: Nira, I want to ask about your own life, which is, I understand that growing up, you came from a family
sentences.zh: 尼拉，我想问问你自己的生活，据我了解，你从小到一个家庭，

sentences.en: that in some ways, prized not demonstrating its commitment to status, that actually prized not
sentences.zh: 这个家庭在某些方面不看重对外展示其对地位的执着，实际上非常珍视

sentences.en: buying the expensive things as a way to show off.
sentences.zh: 不把购买昂贵的东西作为炫耀的方式。

sentences.en: So I'm of East Indian origin, and my parents immigrated to this country.
sentences.zh: 我是东印度裔，我的父母移民到了这个国家。

sentences.en: And it turns out,
sentences.zh: 结果证明，

sentences.en: in East Indian communities, showing your social status is a very, very important thing.
sentences.zh: 在东印度社群中，展示你的社会地位是一件非常非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: So people are
sentences.zh: 所以人们

sentences.en: really, really motivated to show their status.
sentences.zh: 有着极强的动力去展示自己的地位。

sentences.en: And when I was growing up, that was happening through
sentences.zh: 当我长大的时候，这种展示是通过

sentences.en: buying, you know, really expensive cars.
sentences.zh: 购买你知道的非常昂贵的汽车来实现的。

sentences.en: So a lot of my parents' friends, they had Jaguars,
sentences.zh: 所以我父母的很多朋友，他们开着捷豹，

sentences.en: and they had Mercedes.
sentences.zh: 还有奔驰。

sentences.en: And I remember I went to a friend's house one time, and they had a Jaguar.
sentences.zh: 我记得我有一次去一个朋友家，他们家就有一辆捷豹。

sentences.en: She was
sentences.zh: 她

sentences.en: also Indian.
sentences.zh: 也是印度人。

sentences.en: And I asked her, she was complaining about her mom kind of being frugal about different
sentences.zh: 我问她，当时她在抱怨她妈妈在各种事情上

sentences.en: things.
sentences.zh: 比较节俭。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, that's so strange, because, you know, she's frugal, and yet you have a Jaguar.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，这太奇怪了，因为，你知道的，她很节俭，然而你们却有一辆捷豹。

sentences.en: And she said, oh, well, that's just to show off.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，那只是为了炫耀。

sentences.en: And I just, the candidness of that moment really,
sentences.zh: 我当时，那个时刻的坦诚真的

sentences.en: really, you know, sparked something in my mind.
sentences.zh: 真的，你知道的，在我脑海中点燃了某种东西。

sentences.en: Like, wow, people are just trying to show off.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哇，人们真的只是在炫耀。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而且

sentences.en: my mom also would often complain about how all her friends would buy these expensive cars.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈也经常抱怨她所有的朋友都买这些昂贵的汽车。

sentences.en: And the
sentences.zh: 而他们

sentences.en: only reason they were doing it was to show off.
sentences.zh: 这样做的唯一原因就是为了炫耀。

sentences.en: And so I just, I kind of got really fascinated with
sentences.zh: 所以我对展示社会地位这个想法

sentences.en: this idea of showing your social status.
sentences.zh: 变得非常着迷。

sentences.en: And I think, kind of an evidence of how we're,
sentences.zh: 我认为，这正是我们现状的一个证明，

sentences.en: things are shifting now towards, maybe towards something like busyness.
sentences.zh: 事情现在正在向某种方向转变，也许正朝着“忙碌”的方向发展。

sentences.en: Now all her friends are
sentences.zh: 现在她所有的朋友都

sentences.en: retired, and they all brag about how busy they are.
sentences.zh: 退休了，他们都在吹嘘自己有多忙。

sentences.en: And now my mom complains about how everyone
sentences.zh: 而现在我妈妈则在抱怨每个人

sentences.en: talks about how busy they are all the time.
sentences.zh: 都在喋喋不休地谈论自己有多忙。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, it's sort of an evolving,
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，你知道的，这是一种不断演变、

sentences.en: kind of an evolving mechanism.
sentences.zh: 不断演变的机制。
